description: RunBatch with op=score AND non-empty lora_key. Score is base-only on the Python adapter path: ModelWorker.submit_score uses _batchers[None] only. Python must (1) log a WARN, (2) NOT inject options['lora'], and (3) serve the base path successfully — NOT NAK, NOT reject. The pinned invariant: score is unconditionally base-served regardless of lora_key.

notes.rationale: expected_lora_in_options=null even though input.lora_key is non-empty: this is the WARN-and-strip-LoRA contract. The matching log assertion (per side) belongs in language-specific log tests; the parity contract is the wire shape, which must be base-output regardless of the WARN.
